title: Your Fridge Is a Valid Payment Device — Eleonora Drykina & Nina Žižakić, In The Pocket
talk_summary: A fintech RAG chatbot over 270 PDF rulebooks (6,000 pages, 3,000 tables) that needed exact citations and grounding. They built hybrid dense+BM25 retrieval with RRF, agentic multi-tool retrieval with guardrails, streaming UI, and Promptfoo-based evals.

takeaways.technique: Re-run LLM-judge evals to filter noise
takeaways.what_they_do: They re-ran their LLM-judge evaluation and discarded changes whose score deltas did not reproduce; they also audited the rubric itself when the judge kept penalizing a 'hallucinated' date that was actually real source text.
takeaways.evidence_quote: cinco de cada 12 cambios no se reprodujeron

takeaways.technique: Separate retrieval eval from end-to-end eval
takeaways.what_they_do: They ran a retrieval-only eval (63 questions) separate from the 86 end-to-end Promptfoo tests, so they could attribute regressions to retrieval vs generation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: En la evaluación solo de recuperación de 63 preguntas

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of a fixed retrieve-then-generate pipeline, the agent gets tools from narrow to broad (search chunks → fetch section → fetch whole doc → list docs), plus guardrails: refuse oversized docs and return available section names on mismatch so the agent can retry.
takeaways.evidence_quote: nuestro agente tiene cuatro herramientas. De estrecho a amplio
takeaways.numbers: median 38s per answer; 2-4 tool calls typical

takeaways.technique: Search-discipline prompt after N tool calls
takeaways.what_they_do: After ~6 retrieval calls the agent is prompted to ask whether it is finding genuinely new information or just reformulating a failed search, based on observed real looping behavior.
takeaways.evidence_quote: antes de la sexta, se le dice al agente que se pregunte si está buscando algo genuinamente nuevo

takeaways.what_they_do: They never split tables across chunks, detect section headings via regex to attach a section path to each chunk, and use that path both for citations and to re-expand a whole section on demand.
takeaways.evidence_quote: nos aseguramos de nunca dividir una tabla entre dos fragmentos
no se puede transmitir un objeto Pydantic parcial
